test_title: PYST 19: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A # B’ means ‘B is the daughter of A’.

If D # E # F & G @ H # I, then how is G related to E?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 **B is**
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
@

 
 
 
&

 
 
 
**#**

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Husband

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 **to A**
 
 

Statement given : D # E # F & G @ H # I

So,

 
• D # E → E is the daughter of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45279a50424553ca050a64100b1a70402a49168cf1f9143854436be98e851e20.png] 

 
• E # F → F is the daughter of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bdbdf2ac7521c29b6e7bb7c06bbaa3f3bd094caece772f4a7007d0ab32826f2.png] 

 
• F & G → F is the mother of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52d46a0a30750da6393ebd1e104d6956c61d9f6f1cb9f4bbb893c620d1eb1a71.png] 

 
• G @ H → G is the husband of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/227b0e29c20e4cd4a4b33ca8ade21457e2a774807d85bee7b4c21e7cae7f0b31.png] 

 
• H # I → I is the daughter of H.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/180094bd6edea3db305dff1506314c343622e548c7b6227590b7c56c6c6debb5.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree G is the maternal grandson of E i.e Daughter’s son.

Hence, "**Daughter’s son**" is the correct answer.
